answer_text:
1. The survey analyzes over 1400 research papers.
2. LongRoPE achieves 2048K token context windows through two-stage approaches.
3. GPT-4 achieves approximately 20% absolute performance improvement through the Self-Refine method.
4. On general assistant tasks, humans achieve 92% accuracy, while advanced models like GPT-4 achieve only 15% accuracy.
5. The four categories of System Implementations are (1) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), (2) Memory Systems, (3) Tool-Integrated Reasoning, and (4) Multi-Agent Systems.
